annotations.title: Changes kept for App Review: list them, or send them now

description: The changes Ploa keeps while Apple has what they're for with App Review (the App Store text per language, screenshots, app previews, the App Store setup, a product's image, an in-app event…): Apple takes no changes to what it's reviewing, so Ploa keeps them and sends them by itself once Apple has decided. Without send, lists them by language and kind, each with its id, when it was kept and whether Apple refused it. send: true sends them to the App Store now (all, or the ids given), oldest first; one Apple still refuses for App Review stays kept, with the ones of its kind after it. Sending waits for a person's approval (ploa_approval_status gives the answer), unless ploa_access says this agent is autonomous: then it's sent at once, recorded as approved in advance under the agent's name. Needs a token allowed to submit. A person reviews them, sends and cancels one at a time in Ploa (the app's pages show one line with how many are kept).

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.

ids.description: Only these changes (ids from the list). All of them when left out.

send.description: Send them to the App Store now. Leave out to list them.
